summary: Tested the pharmacy NEW ORDER ALERTS (backend /orders/new poll and the NewOrderAlerts pop-up) and the EXPIRY CLEARANCE + REORDER SUGGESTIONS feature (backend /stock-actions and the Stock sub-tabs). Backend: tests/test_pharmacy_alerts_stock_actions.py has 11 tests; 10 passed on the first run. The 1 failure was a transient empty result: the provider app inventory call timed out, and the error was swallowed. The test now retries once. Frontend, all verified live: (1) For the pharmacy, the pop-up appeared within about 6s of a TEST order on /provider, showing the patient, #RXT..., the store and 'TEST_Dolo 650 · 2 · pickup'. (2) The pop-up also appeared on /pharmacy/stock. (3) View order goes to /pharmacy/orders and dismisses the card. (4) Dismiss works. (5) No duplicate card after 2 more polls, after dismissing, or after a reload. (6) Mute toggles localStorage trata_order_alert_muted between 1 and 0, the title updates, and the setting persists across reload. (7) An order placed just before an SPA route change still alerts (Layout is not remounted). (8) No pop-up and no poll requests for hospital or master admin logins. Stock: the all/expiring/reorder sub-tabs work. The expiry list shows 2 Dolo rows, '34 days' and ₹300 at risk. The reorder list shows qty 15 each, basis 'no sales... 2× reorder level 10' and ₹900. The CSV download (reorder-list.csv) has the correct content. Both empty states were checked by mocking the route, and the Download button is hidden when empty. All stock, the table and the stock-add dialog still work. There were no console errors. TEST orders were cleaned up (make_test_order.py cleanup).

minor.issue: load_inventory silently swallows provider-app errors and timeouts (the 30s httpx timeout). The provider app hung in about 1 of 8 to 1 of 12 calls (confirmed with direct curl: one call timed out at 30s). The endpoint then returns 200 with expiring=[] and reorder=[], so the UI wrongly says 'Nothing expires in the next 60 days' or 'Stock levels look healthy'. It should return unreachable_stores (as /prescriptions does) or a 502, and the UI should show a warning. A shorter timeout plus one retry would also help.

server_time comes from the app server clock (datetime.now), but created_at comes from the DB's now(). Clock skew between them could make the first cursor miss orders. Use SELECT now() from Postgres for server_time.
datetime.fromisoformat(exp) on a malformed expiry_date raises ValueError and returns a 500. Wrap it in try/except and skip the row.

sold_for uses substring matching (n in name or name in n), which can over-count: e.g. stock 'Dolo' matches sales of 'Dolo 650' and 'Dolo 500'. Also, an item with reorder_threshold 0, qty 0 and no sales is listed with suggested_qty 0, which is noise. Filter out suggested_qty == 0.

integration_issues.issue: The first poll only runs after 10s (setInterval without an immediate call), and that first poll only sets the cursor. Orders placed in the first ~10s after login or reload never alert. Call poll() once on mount.

design_issues.screen: /provider dashboard while a pop-up is shown
issues: The dashboard 'New orders' tile and 'Latest orders' do not refresh when an alert arrives (still showed 0). Consider triggering a refetch or dispatching an event.

action_items: Surface provider-app inventory failures in /stock-actions and /inventory (unreachable_stores plus a UI warning) instead of showing healthy empty states
In NewOrderAlerts, run poll() immediately on mount
(Optional) Use the DB clock for server_time; guard against a malformed expiry_date; tighten sold-name matching; drop suggested_qty==0 rows
critical_code_review_comments: pharmacy.py load_inventory: return_exceptions=True plus `continue` hides outages. Count them and return the count.
NewOrderAlerts: the seen-set and cursor logic is correct, and the cursor advances to the last created_at. Sound is gated on localStorage each tick. Good.
Layout keeps NewOrderAlerts mounted across route changes (same element type at the same position), so no orders are lost on navigation. Verified.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/11 first run; 1 transient caused by the provider-app timeout)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_pharmacy_alerts_stock_actions.py (about 1 min; it creates and cleans up a TEST order itself). For UI alert tests, schedule `(sleep N; python3 tests/make_test_order.py create) &` AFTER the browser page has mounted for at least 10s; otherwise the order predates the cursor and correctly won't alert. Always run cleanup afterwards. The store inventory currently has only TEST_Dolo 650 and TEST Dolo 650 (qty 5, reorder 10, ₹30, expiry 2026-11-30); TEST_Azithral 500 is no longer present. The container date is Oct 2026.
rca of the issue: Empty stock-actions result: the provider.tratahealth.com /api/pharmacy/{id}/inventory request intermittently hangs for 30s or more. _provider_api raises a 502 HTTPException, which asyncio.gather(return_exceptions=True) captures. load_inventory then skips that store, so the response is a 200 with empty lists.
